reference.retrieval_result: Direct CDS fig4.dat, CDS VizieR table export, and Harvard VizieR mirror timed out from the workspace; no spectrum values were downloaded. The browser research service exposed the CDS ReadMe and registry metadata.
reference.retrieval_route: Open the CDS catalog URL, select J/AJ/167/5/fig4 and export all rows, or obtain fig4.dat through the FTP link shown by the catalog and verify against its ReadMe. Archive original bytes, access time and SHA-256; do not treat the registry update date as a file version.

observation.mode: S200A1 fixed slit, G395M/F290LP, three nods
observation.processing: Authors used ESA NIRSpec custom reduction, calibrated with commissioning standard stars and then rescaled to multi-epoch Spitzer [4.5] photometry; extracted nod spectra were combined with outlier rejection.
observation.distinction: The published author extraction combines observations; it is neither an individual exposure spectrum nor a SPHEREx instrument spectral response.

limitations: The published spectrum and its uncertainties are not an exact ground truth and are not contemporaneous with WISE SPHEREx cutouts.
Spitzer [4.5] sets the absolute scaling; its multi-epoch scatter and other calibration systematics are not independent pointwise errors.
The CDS ReadMe lists per-row errors but does not specify the full wavelength covariance; do not assume independent spectral samples.

Miles et al. 2026 reports wavelength-dependent time variability in NIRSpec time-series data, with CO features up to 10 percent peak-to-peak at some wavelengths; this is a preprint result and not a universal amplitude prior.

A future simulation requires version-locked SPHEREx per-pixel spectral response and PSF, absolute unit conversion and source-noise protocol. A monochromatic interpolation is not equivalent to a bandpass integral.
The author figure 4 table has not been obtained; its license and integrity must be verified separately before caching or redistribution. The retrieved MAST x1d is a different extraction.

astrometry_context.note: Published external astrometry context, not inferred from the spectrum. This object's Table 5 row lists 19 Spitzer epochs, zero WISE epochs in each WISE band and 46 Gaia re-registration stars. Confirm the RA proper-motion convention before numerical propagation. These marginal uncertainties are not a full covariance and do not alone provide a calibrated 2025/2026 positional uncertainty. The current local WISE prior is unchanged.

mast_x1d.selection_rule: DQ equals zero, finite flux and error, strictly positive error; rows kept in source file and parser; negative measured flux remains usable
mast_x1d.caveat: MAST pipeline extraction combining three NRS1 science exposure members; not Luhman authors custom extraction or its Spitzer photometric rescaling, and not a PSF, source detection or SPHEREx bandpass.
